description: baseline: zero-shot Gemma 4 E2B on M3A-format eval

200-step QLoRA at max_new=384; format OK but open_app/navigate_back regressed
500-step QLoRA, lr=2e-4: catastrophic class-collapse (click 67% of preds, input_text/navigate_back→click)
300-step QLoRA on balanced data (250/cls × 6 cls); +1.5pp vs baseline
500-step QLoRA on balanced data; click recovered (66.7) but wait/open_app eroded
300-step QLoRA balanced @ lr=1e-4; under-trained, ties baseline
300-step balanced + schema-anchored Reason; ties run 6 on full but type_match 50→57; open_app crashed 92→42 (app_name-in-Reason coupling)
300-step balanced + schema-anchored Reason w/ open_app decoupled; input_text crashed 65→10
300-step balanced + projector OFF; click type up 56→75 but full and minorities regress
run-6 recipe at seed=2024: full=20.00 vs run-6 22.00; ±2pp seed noise on 200-row eval
baseline @ 500-row eval (segment 2 floor)
run-6 recipe @ 500-row eval; +1.4pp confirmed; scroll +23.7, open_app +25.8
400/cls × 6 = 2400 rows + 400 steps; scroll +19 input_text +5 but open_app/navigate_back regressed
lora_r=32, alpha=64 at run-14 base; new best, +2.6 vs baseline
lora_r=32 + 400 steps; over-balanced — scroll/input_text gain but click loses 11pp
lora_r=32 + 250 steps AC-only; -2.2pp vs r=32@300 best; confirms 300-step needed at higher r
AC+AL mixed train (1000 AC + 500 AL, 250×6 cls) @ run-16 recipe; AW SR 20% (+20pp vs baseline) — first positive AW signal
M3A baseline (no LoRA) on the same 10-task AW slice — segment-3 floor
+status class (250 rows from AL); status type-match still 0% but other classes disrupted; -10pp vs r19
r19 mix + 400 steps; AW SR 50% (+30pp vs r19) — NEW BEST; ClockStopWatchRunning + RecipeDeleteSingleRecipe new wins
r22 + 500 steps; over-trains, input_text crashes 19→5 on AC; lost OpenApp+Recipe wins from r22; -20pp
r22 + 350/cls (2100 rows, 0.76 epoch); under-trained — lost CameraTakePhoto + RecipeDeleteSingleRecipe vs r22; -20pp
r22 + 350/cls + 525 steps (1.0 epoch); lost both Clock tasks vs r22; -30pp; over-trained or over-balanced
r22 verbatim + seed=2024 (reproducibility test); 10% vs r22's 50% — REVEALS HUGE SEED VARIANCE on 10-task eval (~±20pp SD)
PURE-AL ablation (1000 rows × 4 cls, no AC, 268 steps); 10% AW SR; killed OpenAppTaskEval (no open_app in AL data) — confirms AC mixing is load-bearing for AW
r22 verbatim + seed=4242 (3rd variance sample); 20% AW SR. Three-sample r22-recipe distribution: 50/10/20 → mean=26.7%, σ≈21pp. Confirms r22 was upward outlier; recipe true mean ~20-30%

r22 verbatim (default seed=3407) on 20-task slice → 0/20 = 0%. Same recipe/seed/data as r22 (md5 confirmed identical). 4-sample r22-recipe distribution: 50/10/20/0 → mean=20%, σ≈21pp; CUDA non-determinism makes seed-fixed reruns diverge wildly. AC input_text COLLAPSED to 0% (was 37.5% in r22) — recipe is genuinely seed-fragile, not just slice-noisy

input_text x2 boost (500 rows) + 460 steps. AC offline DROPPED to 14.20% (-6.8 vs r29) — boost diluted click/scroll/navigate_back; input_text only moved 0→2.33%. Cancelled before AW. Conclusion: more input_text rows do NOT fix the structural emission problem. Pivoting to pure-a11y for r31

Pure-a11y AC-only (1500 rows, 400 steps, max_length=16384, no images) + new M3AA11Y harness (app inventory, deterministic history, executor feedback, no-op detection). 2/20 = 10% AW SR (ClockStopWatchRunning + OpenAppTaskEval). open_app=96.77 (highest yet); pure-a11y emitted status=2% on AL despite no status training. First pure-a11y data point

Same r31 adapter + M3AA11Y harness PATCHES (no-op widening to scroll/input_text, status guard refusing complete on no-change, answer guard requiring open_app+click first, tolerant JSON parser, max_new_tokens 256→384). 1/20 = 5% AW SR — only OpenAppTaskEval succeeded; ClockStopWatchRunning regressed. Within σ≈7pp of r31's 10% but below best. Harness patches alone do NOT lift SR; variance dominates. Confirms scaffolding cannot compensate for unchanged adapter

Schema parity retrain (--harness-parity flag): AC training rows now emit indexed app inventory + det-history Step format matching M3AA11Y eval prompt. Same recipe as r31 (1500 AC-only rows, --text-only, max_length=16384, 400 steps). 2/20 = 10% AW SR — IDENTICAL tasks to r31 (ClockStopWatchRunning + OpenAppTaskEval). Schema parity was format-neutral, NOT load-bearing. Offline AC type_match COLLAPSED 44.6→23.0 but input_text type_match SURGED 4.65→25.00 — model rebalanced action distribution toward AW-relevant verbs (click/input_text/open_app dominant; scroll/wait/navigate_back collapsed). Net AW result unchanged. Confirms hypothesis: harness investments + adapter alone cannot lift past r31 ceiling. Base model at capacity ceiling on (state,action) imitation. Pivoting to teacher distillation

Teacher distillation (Gemma 4 31B 4-bit) on 1500 harness-parity AC rows. INVALIDATED PRE-TRAIN by data analysis: (1) 96% of AC open_app rows target non-AW-inventory apps (Amazon/Khan Academy/Maps/Gmail/eBay/Vimeo etc., none in the harness 19-app set); (2) 281/329 erroneous teacher status emits were correct infeasibility refusals; (3) salvage step would force student to learn post-hoc rationalizations of actions teacher itself refused. Teacher fails on same classes as student (scroll 11%, navigate_back 2%, wait 3%, input_text 0% full-match) due to shared text-only-prompt deficiencies. Conclusion: data+harness problem, not model capacity. No student trained, no AW eval. Pivoting to r35 = rebuild train data with AW-app filter on AC + re-include AL

r35 AW-distribution data rebuild: AC filtered to AW-inventory open_app only (4727 dropped), 250 synth open_app rows per AW app (4750 total), 50/50 AC/AL mix for shared classes, AL-only for status. 1750 rows balanced. Same recipe + harness as r33 (text-only, harness-parity, 400 steps). 2/20=10% AW SR — IDENTICAL tasks to r31/r33 (ClockStopWatchRunning + OpenAppTaskEval). Data fix did NOT change deployment behavior. Diagnosis: M3AA11Y eval prompt already prepends AW app inventory, which constrained model to AW apps regardless of what it learned to call in training. Contamination was real but not load-bearing for AW SR. AC offline DROPPED full=12.00 (vs r33=9.50; both crashed by AC val containing same off-distribution open_app rows model now correctly avoids). AL type_match SURGED 25→37 driven by click 53→92 (AL data integration). Bottleneck is harness context (per user), not data distribution. Pivoting r36 to reason-preserving history in M3AA11Y

r36 reason-preserving history (harness-only, r35 adapter unchanged): m3a_a11y appended each prior step model `Reason:` text on a second `  reason:` line in the history block. ONLY r35 adapter unchanged. 1/20 = 5% AW SR — LOST ClockStopWatchRunning (which had succeeded in r31/r33/r35). OpenAppTaskEval still works. Diagnosis: prompt distribution shift — model was trained on history WITHOUT reasons, adding them at eval time confuses it (likely interprets prior reasons as part of the user goal, or the extra ~240char/step text dilutes attention budget on relevant elements). User-hypothesized harness-context lever EXISTS but adding raw signal naively is net-negative. Either need to retrain with reasons in history (aligns distribution; ~30-40min) OR pick a different harness change that does NOT shift prompt distribution. Pivoting r37 to candidate-action shortlist header (additive, doesnt restructure history; simpler distribution shift)

r37 retrained WITH reasons-in-history (--history-reasons in prepare_smoke_data; new --history-reasons flag emits `  reason: <synthetic>` line under each prior `Step N:` in train prompts). M3AA11Y harness updated to mirror format (carries action_reason text through history). 1750 rows v3 train, same recipe as r35. 1/20 = 5% AW SR — IDENTICAL FAILURE as r36 (lost ClockStopWatchRunning, only OpenAppTaskEval succeeds). Critical: matching train+eval distribution did NOT fix the regression. RULES OUT prompt-distribution-shift as the cause of r36 failure. Real cause: model uses prior reasons as distraction signal, gets stuck looping (max_steps on trivial 1-button task). Cannot distinguish own-prior-reason from user goal; tries to re-execute the action instead of terminating. AC type_match dropped 40→27 (eval data lacks history-reasons → mild distribution mismatch in opposite direction). Reverting r37 changes; pivoting r38 to compact a11y tree (drop empty-label elements at both train+eval; addresses prompt-budget hypothesis directly without touching history)

r38 cap M3AA11Y eval history to last 3 steps (match training prior_strs[-3:]). Retrained on v2 (no history-reasons). 1/20 = 5% AW SR. SAME REGRESSION AS r36/r37 (lost ClockStopWatchRunning, only OpenAppTaskEval). 3 consecutive harness changes (r36 add reasons eval-only, r37 add reasons train+eval, r38 cap history) all -5pp from r35. UNAMBIGUOUS PATTERN: r35 ClockStopWatchRunning was a fragile stochastic success — the model wasn t solving it, it was lucking into a brittle button-click that worked with one specific prompt config. ANY change to history block breaks it. TRUE base capability of Gemma 4 E2B + SFT-only + text-only on AW-20 is 5% (1 robustly-solved task = OpenAppTaskEval). r35 10% was measurement artifact. AC and AL eval metrics improved this seed (al_full_match 1.20→4.38, type_match 47→47) confirming v2 recipe is solid; AW-20 ceiling is model-capacity bound, not data/harness bound. Next direction must be structural: bigger base model OR vision back on OR much more multi-step training data

r39 fix train/eval newline mismatch: render_m3a_prompt joined element lines with empty string (no newlines), so train prompts had all 25+ elements jammed on one line; eval m3a._generate_ui_elements_description_list put each on own line. Bug present since r33 (harness_parity introduction). Fix: append `\n` per element. Retrained on v5 (newline-fixed) data. 2/20 = 10% AW SR — recovers r35 baseline (Clock + OpenApp). Bug fix is REAL infrastructure improvement (eliminates known train/eval mismatch) but does NOT lift past r35 ceiling. Confirms structural floor at 10% for Gemma 4 E2B + SFT-only + text-only paradigm. Bug fix kept; metric discarded. Next r40 = step up base to gemma-4-E4B-it-unsloth-bnb-4bit (2x params, same arch/template/processor — drop-in upgrade)

r40 step up base model from Gemma 4 E2B (2B) to E4B (4B, 4-bit Unsloth quant). Same v5 train data, same recipe, same M3AA11Y harness. AW-20 = 2/20 = 10% — IDENTICAL TASKS as r39 (Clock + OpenApp). E4B did NOT lift AW SR despite MASSIVE offline gains: AC full 13.5→18.5 (+5pp), type 41→51 (+10pp), input_text type 20→85 (+65pp), open_app 67→100, AL full 1.59→3.19 (2x), AL scroll 6→26. train_loss 0.6282→0.4794. CONCLUSION: action-grounding capacity is NOT the AW bottleneck. E4B picks right action GIVEN where to go, but still cannot sequence multi-step tasks. Goal decomposition is the missing skill. Pivoting r41 to plan distillation on E4B base (user-approved direction)

r41 plan distillation: teacher (Gemma 4 31B 4-bit) generated 595 plans for unique AL goals; injected as Plan: header at step 0 of training and Plan from step 0: in step 1+ user prompts. v6 train data, E4B base, plan-aware M3AA11Y harness (parses plan from step-0 emission, re-injects in step 1+). 1/20 = 5% AW SR (only OpenAppTaskEval). MAJOR offline lifts: AL full DOUBLED (3.19→6.37, highest of any run), AC navigate_back FIRST EVER non-zero (0→18.18), AC wait 5→63, AC scroll 27→40. But AW REGRESSED 10→5 because plans trained model to emit status:complete prematurely (every plan ends with X. status: complete; model generalizes and emits status before task actually done; harness max-step counts confirm: e.g. Run the stopwatch was Agent indicates done + Failed). Plan distillation works at offline grounding but status contagion kills AW completion. Pivoting r43 to drop status emission entirely (let harness time-out be only termination)

r43 drop status emission entirely. Status removed from M3A_PROMPT_PREFIX vocab; m3a_a11y suppresses any status emission (logs feedback, no termination). Plans rebuilt to strip trailing X. status: complete step (al_plans_no_status.jsonl). v7 train data drops status class entirely (1500 rows, 6-class balance). E4B base. KEEP rationale: 2/20 AW SR matches r39/r40/r41-best but TASKS ARE DIFFERENT — ClockStopWatchRunning (fragile stochastic success across r31-r40) LOST; CameraTakeVideo NEWLY SOLVED. CameraTakeVideo is a real 2-step task (open Camera + click record button). FIRST TIME across r19-r43 we have seen a previously-unsolved AW task succeed. Proof that status-drop + plan distillation forces actual multi-step execution instead of premature terminate. Structural progress despite tied metric. AC offline mostly recovered: full=17, type=49.5 (click 58, scroll 73, open_app 92), only input_text dropped to 0 (model preferring click for what was input_text rows; needs investigation). AL full_match=6.37 ties r41 highest. Path forward: r44 = AL volume rebuild (test if more multi-step trajectory data lifts past 10%) before committing to r42 (teacher rollouts, ~1-2 day eng)

r44 remove m3a_a11y no-op auto-declare (reusing r43 adapter, harness-only). All 20 tasks hit max_steps with 0 successes — INCLUDING OpenAppTaskEval which had succeeded in EVERY run since r19. CRITICAL FINDING: the no-op auto-declare was the ONLY mechanism in the harness that terminated trajectories at states where AW env-side success check could fire on a SUCCESSFUL state. Without it, max_steps termination leaves env in over-acted state (e.g., camera continuously recording without finalizing video, app navigated past the open-with-permissions success state). Reverted m3a_a11y.py to r43 no-op behavior. CONCLUSION: harness termination strategy is load-bearing infrastructure for AW scoring; removing it without replacing with a smarter terminator is destructive. Path forward: address model grounding errors (wrong app selection, out-of-range indices observed in r43 trajectories) through better training data, not harness changes. Pivoting r45 to r42 (teacher rollouts on AL tasks for clean on-distribution multi-step trajectories)

r45 increase per-class-target 250→500 (3000 rows train, 800 max_steps). E4B + plans-no-status + status dropped. ALL-TIME HIGH AC offline: full=29 (prev best 23.4 r16), type=64 (prev best 58 r43). All 6 classes non-zero, most balanced ever. AL competitive at 5.98 full. AW-20 = 0/20 — INCLUDING OpenAppTaskEval (which had succeeded in nearly every prior run). DEFINITIVE EVIDENCE: more training data on the current distribution is actively HARMFUL. Model overfit to AC/AL UI patterns and lost the AW launcher behavior. Dataset is structurally wrong for AW. Path forward: investigate AW train splits (option C), improve synth open_app with realistic launcher UI (option A), or build templated AW-style task generator with teacher gold actions (option B)

r46 diversified open_app synth templates (10 phrasings per AW app, 141 unique synth goals across 4750 synth rows; train v9 = 1500 rows). E4B + plans-no-status. AW-20 = 1/20 = 5%, below 10% peak. AC offline 24.5/49 mid-tier, AL 6.37/35.06 mid-tier. Offline–AW correlation remains broken across r33-r46 (12 runs). User commits to pivot: drop AC + AL + synth-open-app entirely; r47 trains on TEACHER-SYNTHESIZED TRAJECTORIES ONLY (OS-Genesis-style on AW-19 apps), then r48 RFT once student SR is non-zero. Literature confirms ≤4B + AC ceiling ~10% AW; only ≤4B path past 15% is in-AW-distribution data (OS-Genesis InternVL2-4B = 15.18%)

r47 OS-Genesis pivot: teacher (Gemma 4 31B 4bit) rolled 95 trajectories on 19 AW apps using self-synthesized goals (no AC/AL/synth). Filtered to 75 trajectories (success/recovery/exploratory; dropped premature/loop). 434 training rows. Hit 2 critical bugs: (a) genesis prompts were too verbose (M3A renderer) — caused NaN training; fixed by reformatting to smoke_v9 layout. (b) Patched M3AA11Y to use matching prompt format at eval. Train loss 6.31→0.71 cleanly. Offline AC=26.0/59.5 (mid-tier, input_text=90 strong, navigate_back=0), AL=1.59/25.5 (low — distribution mismatch). AW-20 = 1/20 = 5% (only RecipeDeleteSingleRecipe passed). FAILURE MODE: model trained without status emission (deliberate from r43); at eval has no termination signal so over-acts (e.g. takes 5 photos when goal is 1, then max_steps cap fires AW success check on wrong env state). r48 will restore status-at-trajectory-end in training data so model learns when to stop.

r48 RESTORE STATUS in genesis training. Genesis_to_train.py keeps through first status emission (was: drop all status). m3a_format M3A_PROMPT_PREFIX restored status:complete + status:infeasible vocab. m3a_a11y status handler is terminal (with guard requiring open_app + click before allowing complete). 495 rows (61 status), 75 trajectories. Train loss 6.31 -> 0.73 clean. AC offline 22/56.5 (open_app=100, input_text=80, click=63 — open_app perfect, was 75 in r47). AL low (2.4 — distribution mismatch expected). AW-20 = 3/20 = 15.0% — FIRST TIME hitting 15% threshold. Successes: ClockStopWatchRunning (perennial), RecipeDeleteSingleRecipe (also r47), OpenAppTaskEval (Contacts) NEWLY recovered (was lost since r43). Failure analysis on 6 trajectories: model never emits status:complete despite restored vocab — keeps clicking shutter/buttons until max_steps. Hypothetical perfect-status ceiling: +1-3 tasks (CameraTakePhoto certain, CameraTakeVideo+ClockStopWatchPaused maybe). 4/6 fails are GROUNDING errors (wrong indices/text) not status. Training data biased toward 'give up': 38 status:infeasible vs 23 status:complete; 35/49 recovery trajectories end in infeasible (teacher gave up). r49: rebuild genesis with success-only filter + simpler goals so teacher succeeds more.

r49 drop status:infeasible-ending trajectories from genesis training. Hypothesis: teacher 'gave up' demos teach student to give up. Removed 38 infeasible-ending trajectories: 75 traj/495 rows -> 37 traj/290 rows. Train loss 0.60 (better fit on cleaner data). AW-20 = 2/20 = 10% — REGRESSION from r48 15%. Lost ClockStopWatchRunning (perennial winner across r19-r48), lost OpenAppTaskEval. Two new wins: MarkorDeleteNote ✅, RecipeDeleteSingleRecipe ✅. ROOT CAUSE: open_app offline metric crashed 100->50 — those infeasible trajectories were carrying important open_app exemplars (teacher opens app correctly, then fails at the actual task). Net effect: lost open-app grounding > gained from removing give-up demos. Reverted genesis_to_train.py. r48 adapter saved to outputs/r49/checkpoint-final pre-overwrite. r48 wins; will retrain r48 + launch AW-116. Lesson: trajectory ENDS may be bad demos, but trajectory MIDDLES (especially open_app step 0) are still valuable — don't drop whole trajectory; consider truncating before status:infeasible step instead.

r48 AW-116 FULL BENCHMARK: 9/116 = 7.76%. AW-20 (15%) was unlucky-easy slice. Wins distributed: 4 Settings (Bluetooth, BrightnessMax, WifiOn, WifiOff), 2 Recipe-delete (1 single + 1 with-constraint), 1 Camera (Video, NOT Photo), 1 Clock (StopWatchRunning - perennial), 1 OpenAppTaskEval. NO question-answering tasks succeeded (NotesIs/MeetingAttendee/TodoItemCount/Calendar QA all failed) — confirms 0-answer-row training data prediction. Settings tasks succeeded BECAUSE Gemma E4B base model has Settings UI knowledge; LoRA didn't poison since Settings was 0-success-demo (model fell back to base). Same for Camera (only video succeeded since multi-step). Lessons: (a) AW-20 is NOT representative of AW-116 (15% vs 8%), need bigger smoke; (b) zero-success-demo apps where base knowledge wins should not be trained — confirms r51 plan to drop them; (c) answer-action absence kills entire QA task class. Next: r51 = drop 6 poison apps + add answer examples.

r51 drop 6 poison apps (Camera/Files/Settings/OsmAnd/Draw/VLC — 0 success demos each) + add 10 synthetic answer-action examples (Joplin/Calendar/OpenTracks/Tasks QA). 75 traj/495 rows -> 42 traj/231 rows + 10 synth. Train loss 0.568 (best yet). AW-20 = 3/20 = 15.0% — TIES r48. Same 3 wins (ClockStopWatchRunning/OpenAppTaskEval/RecipeDeleteSingleRecipe). Lost CameraTakeVideo (Camera dropped from train, no surprise). NotesIsTodo INVESTIGATION: synthetic answer training WORKED — model emits answer(text='True'). But m3a_a11y harness blocks answer with same _has_attempted_navigation guard as status:complete (requires open_app + click). Model navigates with input_text instead of click → answer rejected 3 times. After click step, answer accepted but content was hallucinated (model said 'True' without reading screen — synth data taught format not reasoning). KEEP rationale: ties metric, adds answer capability (was 0), structurally simpler dataset. Open_app=41.67 confirms r49 hypothesis: dropping infeasible-only apps drops open_app exemplars. Next: fix harness answer guard + r52 vision mode (TEXT_ONLY=0).

r52 VISION ON at eval time — same r51 LoRA + harness fix for answer guard (relaxed open_app+click → any successful action). New agent m3a_gemma4_lora_a11y_vision (M3AA11Y harness with text_only=False so wrapper passes screenshots). NO RETRAINING — tests Gemma 4 E4B's pretrained multimodal capability against text-trained adapter. AW-20 = 4/20 = 20.0% — NEW PROJECT HIGH (was 15% across r48 and r51). Vision uplifted MarkorCreateFolder and MarkorDeleteNote (both NEW WINS — never succeeded before across r19-r51). LOST OpenAppTaskEval which had been a perennial winner (vision distraction on simple permission-grant screen). Net +1 task. CONFIRMS: text-only training was a major ceiling. Even pretrained-vision-only at inference with text-trained adapter delivers +5 points. Path forward: r53 = RETRAIN with vision (proper multimodal training, screenshots in train data) — should unlock more wins by aligning train/eval distribution. Also: AW-116 with r52 to verify the AW-20 lift generalizes.

r52 VISION-INFERENCE AW-116 = 10/116 ≈ 8.6% (estimate). Emulator hung at task 104 (a11y tree fetch failure after WiFi-off task). 107 tasks attempted, 10 successful. Beats r48 text-only (9/116=7.76%) by +1 task. Vision unlocked: MarkorCreateFolder, MarkorDeleteNote, RecipeDeleteSingleWithRecipeWithNoise, SystemBrightnessMinVerify (4 new wins). Lost vs r48: SystemBluetoothTurnOnVerify, SystemBrightnessMaxVerify, SystemWifiTurnOffVerify+On (4 Settings tasks where vision distracted). Net +0/116 directly but +1 if WiFi tasks completed. KEY INSIGHT: AW-20 reading of 20% (4/20) = bias from Markor/Recipe-heavy slice where vision helps most; AW-116 has many Settings + QA tasks where vision adds noise. Vision-inference-only with TEXT-trained LoRA = modest uplift (~+1 task) but not the +5 AW-20 suggested. r53 vision-trained LoRA (now with vision-tower-frozen fix) would learn to USE vision properly and may exceed r52. Next: retry r53 with frozen vision tower fix, then AW-116.

r53 vision retrain BLOCKED. 4 attempts: r53a (default config) NaN; r53b (frozen vision tower) NaN; r53c (lr=2e-5) NaN on first step; r53d (eager attention) NaN. Loss is NaN on FIRST forward pass before any gradient updates → numerical issue in Gemma-4 multimodal SFT pipeline (Unsloth FastVisionModel + bf16 + 226-row image dataset). Fix would require deeper Unsloth/Gemma-4 internals work beyond autoresearch scope. Best result remains r52 vision-inference: 20% AW-20, 8.6% AW-116. Path forward (next session): (a) downgrade Unsloth/transformers versions to a known-working multimodal SFT combo, (b) switch to non-Unsloth multimodal training (raw HF + accelerate), (c) try Qwen2.5-VL-3B which has more stable Unsloth support per recent docs, or (d) commit to r52 inference-only path and squeeze more from r51 LoRA + better data quality.

r55 train r51 data with MAX_STEPS=800 (2x r51's 400). Loss healthy through epoch 5 (step 400, loss ~0.26), collapsed to NaN at epoch 10 (step 660+). Overfit + numerical instability after 10 passes through 241-row dataset. r51 recipe at 400 steps is at the edge of stability — doubling steps pushes over. CONCLUSION on Gemma-4-Unsloth path: we have hit the ceiling. r48 (text-only, 7.76% AW-116) and r52 (vision inference, 8.62% AW-116) are the project records. Multimodal SFT, longer training, vision-teacher data — all blocked by NaN/instability bugs in current Unsloth+Gemma-4 stack. To break past 10% AW-116: switch model framework (Qwen2.5-VL-3B with proper Unsloth support, or InternVL2.5-4B per OS-Genesis recipe), OR build env-side RFT loop (filter teacher trajectories by env-verified success).

r57b — switched base model to Qwen3.5-4B (text-only, ~4B). Same r51 train data (241 rows, drop-poison + answer-synth). Fixed train_smoke.py to use ChatML markers (<|im_start|>user/assistant) instead of Gemma's <|turn>. Train loss 0.148 (vs Gemma r48 0.73). AC offline 23.0/53.5 (matches/beats r48 22.0/56.5). open_app=100 (perfect, matches Gemma best). AL full=3.59 (between r48 2.39 and r51 4.78), AL type=33.07 (BEST yet, vs r48 26.29), al_status=16 (vs r48 2 — Qwen learned status emission much better). AW-20 BLOCKED — emulator dead since r52 wifi-off task; needs manual restart. Implication: Qwen3.5-4B is at LEAST as good as Gemma E4B on offline metrics, with BETTER status emission. Likely AW-20 will see uplift over Gemma if emulator restored.

r58 — Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct text-only on r51 data. Train clean (loss 0.21 in 7min, fastest yet). EVAL BROKEN: AC=0/0, parse=29%. Sample preds: model outputs free-form conversational text (eBay shopping advice, Q&A reformulations) instead of Reason/Action JSON. Same eval pipeline worked for Qwen3.5-4B (r57b 23/53.5) so issue is specific to Qwen2.5-VL — likely the vision-aware chat template injects image placeholders even in text-only mode, confusing generation. Would need separate eval pathway for Qwen-VL models. DISCARD. r57b Qwen3.5-4B remains the strongest non-Gemma adapter.

r59 — Qwen3-4B (text-only base, no vision tower). Train pipeline uses UnslothVisionDataCollator which raises TypeError on non-vision models. Would need FastLanguageModel pathway in train_smoke.py for true text-only models. r57b Qwen3.5-4B works because it has vision capability even when used in text-only mode.

r60 attempt to enable text-only Qwen3-4B via trl collator fallback. Failed: trl in this venv doesn't export DataCollatorForCompletionOnlyLM. Would need different collator or version bump. STOPPING text-only Qwen variants — r57b Qwen3.5-4B works fine and waiting on emulator restart for AW-20.

r56 — Gemma E4B + r51 data + 600 steps (vs r51's 400). Train loss 0.40 (vs r51 0.57). AC offline 22/53.5 (matches r48). AL 3.59/28.69 (matches r51, status=6 vs r51's 12). AW-20 = 3/20 = 15% — ties r48 and r51. KEY: NEW WIN on ClockStopWatchPausedVerify (never succeeded before in any run since r19!). Lost OpenAppTaskEval (perennial winner) — overfit on Clock at expense of simple permission tap. Net: same metric but different task profile. Suggests longer training trades simple-task wins for harder-task wins. Worth AW-116 to see if Clock-Pause generalizes (more Clock tasks in full bench).

r56 AW-116 = 9/116 = 7.76% — exact tie with r48 baseline. r56's 600-step training (vs r51's 400) doesn't generalize.
